_comment: H89 seam 4: the why of a passed catcher is conditional on what the rest of the band actually did. Each mutant disables one branch of _other_members_note.
subject: a passed catcher's why names failed band members, says none failed, or says it ran alone

mutants.label: W1 a one-member band is reported as if others ran
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^    if )(?=not others:\n        return \"and it is the only band member that ran\"$)

mutants.label: W2 failed band members are never named
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^    if )(?=failed:\n        return f\"while other band member\(s\) failed \{failed\}\"$)
